description: Animate anything in a shot (shot_id, or scene + shot; left out: the shot on screen) by hand with keyframes on a track. Tracks: "cast:<member id>" (x, y, z, size, spin, turn), "item:<item id>" (x, z, size), "text:<text id>" (x, y, size), "light:<light id>" (x, y, z, intensity, color), "scene:light" (level, ambient), "mask:shot", "adjust:<group>", "element:<id>". op set puts values at a time (a first key after 0 also keys the resting value at 0), remove deletes the key at that time, clear drops the track. One undo step for the person. For ready-made moves use direct_cast; for the camera use set_camera keys.

ease.description: How it travels on to the next key: smooth, even, fast-start, slow-start, punch, bounce.

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

track.description: Which thing, like "cast:member-1" or "scene:light" (ids from get_shot).

name: set_keyframes
